alt: A short film with no voice. A pink room. Two small block figures with doorway legs and white eyes, one in ink and one in cobalt blue, look down at their own sides where hands would be, then at each other. They walk together and bump bodies softly, eyes happy. They back up, then bump again with a running start, hop once together, and go back to their places. The words No hands. We bump. stay on screen.
